name: a2a-agent-studio-backend
description: A2A Agent Studio - Backend orchestrator. No dependencies here, just scripts.

scripts.install:all: cd agents/ava && npm install && cd ../charge-verification && npm install && cd ../card-replacement && npm install && cd ../../agent-platform && npm install
scripts.install:agents: cd agents/ava && npm install && cd ../charge-verification && npm install && cd ../card-replacement && npm install
scripts.start:agents: npx concurrently "npm run start:ava" "npm run start:charge-verification" "npm run start:card-replacement"
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently "npm run start:agents" "npm run start:mcp" "npm run start:platform"
